rows.en: Touya: "Whew... That was a good meal..."
Yamato: "...Hey, isn't that Kasumi?"
Touya: "Looks like it. What's she doing?"
Yamato: "Does that look like playing around to you?
She's clearing everyone's dishes.
Is she doing it all by herself?"
Touya: "..."
Help her.
Leave so I don't get in the way.
Touya: "All right. I'll help her."
Kasumi: "Oh, Touya, you don't have to.
I'll take care of that."
Touya: "Don't worry about it. Two people are better than one.
Let's get this cleared away and finish up quickly."
Kasumi: "...Are you sure?"
Touya: "I told you, don't worry about it."
Kasumi: "Okay... Then I'd appreciate your help."
Touya: "All right. Leave it to me.
I should start by carrying the dishes over, right?"
Kasumi: "Yes. And when you've finished that..."
Touya: "All done!"
Yamato: "Aaah... My jaw's tired..."
Kasumi: "Thanks for your help, both of you."
Touya: "...But why were you cleaning up alone?"
Kasumi: "Huh? Because it was my turn."
Yamato: "Oh, come to think of it, I heard the women
set up a rotation to take turns..."
Touya: "Huh... So that's why..."
Kasumi: "I can handle the rest myself.
Thank you so much."
Touya: "Well, let me know whenever you need anything."
Yamato: "That's right. You tend to take everything on yourself, Kasumi.
You should use whatever help you can get."
Kasumi: "Thank you. I'll do that next time."
Touya: "See you, then."
Kasumi: "Okay."
Leone: "Oh, Touya! Hey, show me around!"
Touya: "Huh?"
Leone: "I want you to show me around inside Liebhofen."
Touya: "This isn't a tourist attraction.
I can't do that."
Leone: "Whyyy? Surely that much is okay.
Are you carrying something you don't want me to see?"
Touya: "That's not it, but..."
Captain Roa: "..."
Touya: "Oh, C-Captain... How long have you been there?"
Captain Roa: "Hmm..."
Leone: "Hey, who's this?"
Touya: "Oh, he's in charge of this ship."
Leone: "Hmm... He does have an air of authority.
Oh, that's right. I'm interested in this ship.
Would you mind letting me look around?"
Captain Roa: "...Mm."
Leone: "Huh? Really?
You can't change your mind later, okay?"
Captain Roa: "Mm."
Leone: "Thank you! Touya, he said it's okay."
Touya: "...I don't think that's what he meant..."
Leone: "Come on, let's go!"
All right, I guess I have to.
No means no.
Leone: "That's more like it!"
Touya: "Hey, don't grab my arm! Stop clinging to me!"
Leone: "What's the harm? After all, it's you and me."
Touya: "What's that supposed to mean?!"
Touya: "Enough with the fake crying. Come on, let's go!"
Leone: "Oh, hey, wait for me!"
Leone: "Wow, it really is huge. Something this massive
can fly... Technology has come so far."
Touya: "Why are you getting all thoughtful about it?
Sure, you probably haven't seen anything this big, but you must have seen
something similar before, right?"
Leone: "Uh, w-well, yes..."
Touya: "?"
Leone: "Wow! Amazing, amazing!
So this is Liebhofen's nerve center..."
Ymir: "Um... Please don't fiddle with the instruments too much."
Leone: "Okaaay."
Ymir: 'The captain told me about this. But stop
before you go too far, okay? This ship is classified, after all.
It isn't up to us to decide what we can show her.'
Touya: 'Yeah, I know.'
Ymir: 'I know it's a lot to ask, but I'm counting on you.'
Leone: "Hey, what are you whispering about?"
Ymir: "N-Nothing. It's nothing."
Leone: "Hmm... Oh well.
Hey, Touya, let's go somewhere else."
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Leone: "So there's a place like this too...
It's pretty nice."
Touya: "Hey, let's make this our last stop."
Leone: "Awww."
Touya: "Don't give me that. This ship is ridiculously huge.
I can't show you every last bit of it."
Leone: 'Hmm... That's true.
I have a rough idea of where everything is now,
so I should be fine on my own from here...'
Touya: "What are you muttering about?"
Leone: "Nothing, nothing. Anyway..."
Leone: "Doesn't this feel kind of like a date?"
Touya: "Wha...! J-Just when I thought you couldn't say anything crazier..."
Leone: "Hey, want to hold hands?"
Touya: "That's it, I'm done!"
Leone: "Oh, I'm only joking...
Aah, don't abandon me!"
Touya: "Hey! Don't say things people will get the wrong idea about!"
Leone: "Ohhh, are you getting embarrassed?"
Touya: "I'm not embarrassed!"
Leone: "Oh, come on."
Touya: "That's it. Do whatever you want."
Leone: "...Oh."
Yamato: "Are you sure it was okay to leave Leone behind?"
Touya: "Well, she probably won't do anything crazy. She'll be fine."
Yamato: "...I hope so."
Leone: "Awww!"
Touya: "We're only letting you stay aboard temporarily.
You need to keep that in mind..."
Touya: "...Hey, where are you going?"
Leone: "Where else? To look around..."
Touya: "Were you listening to a word I said?
Stop wandering around!"
Leone: "But I'm bored."
Touya: "No means no.
If you can't follow that rule, we can put you off the ship right now."
Leone: "Ugh... F-Fine.
I'll behave, all right?! Bleh!"
Touya: "...Honestly, you're just like a little kid."
